summary: Established the BRANCH.TEST Kerberos realm on node1. The analyst principal can obtain a ticket for reports/node2.branch.test, and node2's application keytab validates it. Configuration survived sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible MIT Kerberos packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured and enabled the BRANCH.TEST KDC on node1.
Installed the service keytab at /srv/legacy2/kerberos-service-identity/reports.keytab on node2.
Preserved the existing principal ownership notes.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: BRANCH.TEST realm and required principals exist on node1
evidence.summary: KDC is active on port 88 with analyst and reports service principals present before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Analyst can obtain the report-service ticket and the application keytab validates it
evidence.summary: Both validations obtained the service ticket at KVNO 2 and reported 'keytab entry valid', including after both restarts.
The node2 keytab contains AES256 and AES128 entries for reports/node2.branch.test@BRANCH.TEST and persisted across restart.
The original realm-notes.txt and principals.tsv contents remained unchanged throughout configuration and restarts.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Alpine Linux 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.
